entries.en: Remember that... Kaneshiro guy?[n]The one from the mafia who ended[n]up on the news a while back?

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: Well, the money he was gathering[n]all went to Shido-san.

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: Indeed—as well as that old man[n]Madarame.

entries.speaker: Shadow TV President
entries.en: His counterfeit business, along with[n]Kaneshiro's mafia, aided Shido-san[n]quite a lot financially.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, you were forcin' the news to be[n]about Akechi and Shido all the time,[n]right? I'm sick of 'em!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Wait, this guy's not a real person.[n]Tellin' him ain't gonna do shit for us.

entries.speaker: Haru
